cd /workspace/tests && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace/tests")
from run_sub import run

def check_schema(out):
    assert set(out) == {"runs","audits","diagnostic"}, out.keys()
    for r in out["runs"]:
        assert set(r) == {"query","profile","rcode","termination","final_name","answer","trace"}, set(r)
        assert r["rcode"] in ("NOERROR","NXDOMAIN","SERVFAIL","REFUSED")
        assert r["termination"] in ("ANSWER","NODATA","CNAME_STOP","NXDOMAIN","LOOP","LIMIT","OUTSIDE","EXTERNAL")
        assert isinstance(r["answer"], list) and isinstance(r["trace"], list) and len(r["trace"]) >= 1
        assert r["final_name"].endswith(".") or r["final_name"] == "."
        for a in r["answer"]:
            assert set(a) == {"owner","type","data"}, set(a)
            assert a["type"] in ("A","AAAA","TXT","CNAME")
            assert a["owner"].endswith(".") or a["owner"] == "."
            assert a["owner"] == a["owner"].lower()
            if a["type"] == "CNAME": assert a["data"].endswith(".") or a["data"] == "."
            if a["type"] == "A": assert len(a["data"].split(".")) == 4
            if a["type"] == "AAAA": assert "%" not in a["data"]
        for t in r["trace"]:
            assert t == t.lower() and (t.endswith(".") or t == ".")
    for a in out["audits"]:
        assert set(a) == {"id","verdict","different"}, set(a)
        assert a["verdict"] in ("match","divergence","unobserved")
        assert all(d in ("rcode","answer") for d in a["different"])
        assert a["different"] == [d for d in ("rcode","answer") if d in a["different"]]
        if a["verdict"] != "divergence": assert a["different"] == []
    d = out["diagnostic"]
    assert set(d) == {"equivalence","basis","cost","count"}, set(d)
    for c in d["equivalence"]:
        assert isinstance(c, list) and c == sorted(c)
    assert d["equivalence"] == sorted(d["equivalence"])
    assert d["basis"] == sorted(set(d["basis"]))
    assert isinstance(d["cost"], int) and isinstance(d["count"], int)
    assert d["count"] == len(d["basis"])

rng = random.Random(5)
NAMES=["a.t.","b.t.","*.t.","x.y.t.","t."]
for i in range(200):
    zones=[{"origin":"t.","records":[{"owner":rng.choice(NAMES),"type":"A","data":"1.2.3.4"}]}]
    doc={"zones":zones,
         "profiles":[{"id":"p%d"%j,"max_aliases":j,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"} for j in range(2)],
         "queries":[{"id":"q","name":rng.choice(NAMES),"type":"A","cost":3}],
         "observations":[{"id":"o","query":"q","profile":"p0","result":{"status":"response","rcode":"NOERROR","answer":[]}}]}
    out = run(doc)
    check_schema(out)
print("schema OK on 200 random docs")
PYEOF
